controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-30T06:17:32.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T06:17:32.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*),
        distinct_paths = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.path),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip
| SORT requests DESC
